prompts:
Use case: illustration-story. Generate zealot-b.png, a production animation sprite sheet for Riley Wheel Brawl 2.0. Input Image 1 is the LOCKED character design reference. Match that exact stern clean-shaven square-jawed man, conical steel helmet with nasal guard, steel breastplate and mail, white tabard with large gold sunburst on left breast, white wool cloak with muddy ragged hem, brown leather gloves/belt/boots, steel greaves. Preserve the reference's exact round white wooden sunburst shield with steel rim and boss, and straight steel arming sword with brass crossguard and round pommel. These props must have constant physical size and shape in all poses.

Canvas EXACTLY 1536x1024 landscape, genuinely transparent RGBA background, no floor or shadow. EXACTLY EIGHT full-body figures, two rows of four, reading order. Equal 384x512 cells, clear transparent gaps, no overlap, no cropping. Same character/body scale throughout, scaled uniformly from master to fit sheet; maximize figures while fitting sword and cloak inside each cell. Shared boot baseline per row near y=490 and y=1000. All eight faces and bodies face LEFT, enemy to left. Left arm holds shield toward left, right hand sword; do not swap hands. Correct anatomy: two arms, two legs, two booted feet, five fingers per hand (naturally concealed where appropriate).

Eight DISTINCT sequential drawings:
Top row cell 1 READY: sword raised beside head, shield forward left.
Top row cell 2 WIND-UP: right sword arm drawn high behind head to screen right, torso coiled back.
Top row cell 3 SLASH: big diagonal downward sword cut toward LEFT, front knee bent, right sword arm extended left, blade pointing down-left.
Top row cell 4 FOLLOW-THROUGH: sword low across body near right knee, torso leaning forward left.
Bottom row cell 1 SLASH RECOVERY: pulling sword back up, stepping back into stance.
Bottom row cell 2 SHIELD CHARGE ANTICIPATION: crouched low behind forward-left shield, shoulder pressed into shield, rear boot digging in.
Bottom row cell 3 SHIELD CHARGE RUN STRIDE 1: sprinting LEFT behind shield, body leaning far forward left, LEFT boot forward, right boot trailing.
Bottom row cell 4 SHIELD CHARGE RUN STRIDE 2: RIGHT boot forward, left boot trailing, still leaning hard LEFT behind shield.

House style exactly like reference: hand-drawn HD 2D fighting-game sprite illustration in spirit of Streets of Rage 4; confident near-black/dark-brown outlines thick outside thinner inside, clean 2-3 tone cel shading with subtle painterly gradients, moderate baked light upper LEFT and gentle cool right rim. Grounded rich colors, readable silhouettes. No pixel art, no 3D, no photorealism, no chibi. No blood/gore. No dust, effects, motion lines, text, labels, borders, frame numbers. Do not repeat poses or mirror drawings. Shield circle diameter and sword length remain identical across all eight frames. Transparent empty pixels around isolated sprites, no background color or checkerboard painted in.
